tokenize_json_file: tokenize a JSON file of source code documents using a language-specific tokenizer
extract_functions_file: extract standalone and class functions from a tokenized code file for a given language
regroup_and_select_data: regroup multiple files, shuffle them, and select a specified number of lines into an output file
apply_bpe_file: apply Byte Pair Encoding tokenization to a file using fastBPE
create_symlink: create a symbolic link from a source file path to a symlink destination
